text:
alex: quick ping — can someone take a look at PR #4321? https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321. It's a small runtime tweak: shrink KV prefetch fence (32->8) for short sequences and add a gentle backoff in the batcher when prefetch miss rate spikes. Want to merge before tonight's release window (20:00 PT). Tests + a local smoke perf run passed for me.

ci-bot: CI ✅ build passed (linux, macOS), unit tests OK.

maria: skimmed the diff — looks reasonable. what's the safety net if we see higher tail latency after reducing the fence? any canary plan?

alex: good q — default rollout is canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%, with automatic fallback to current model if 95th latency > baseline + 50ms. added metrics emitted under runtime.kv.prefetch.miss_rate so the console should flag regressions.

sanjay: quick note: on long sequences this change might increase token re-computation cost if we miss more often. did you run a 2k token trace?

alex: ran a 2k trace locally; end-to-end latency up ~8ms for that contrived case but throughput for typical chat loads improved ~6%. I can add a conditional about max_seq_len > 1024 keep old fence.

liz: I can take a look now. will post comments inline.

jamal: heads-up — in batcher/shard_manager.go around line 318 you probably want to update the prefetch backoff math to avoid integer div by zero when miss_count is 0, small nit but worth fixing.

alex: thanks, good catch — i'll push a small change to guard that.

liz: left two tiny suggestions: 1) add a unit test for the backoff edge case, 2) spell out the rollout plan in the PR description. both quick.

alex: pushed fixes and tests in a2b7f9e. updated PR description with rollout steps and dashboards to monitor.

ci-bot: CI ✅ build passed (linux), flaky test fixed by updated unit.

liz: LGTM, leaving approving review. :thumbsup:

maria: quick +1 as well, thanks for adding rollout docs.

sanjay: will watch canary metrics during rollout.

alex: awesome — merging on the next minor quiet window unless someone objects. Thanks all!

jamal: no objections.

alex: merging in 10m if no further flags.
